biggest_catch: The $550 annual fee eats the bonus: 200,000 Hilton Honors points are worth roughly $1,000 at ~0.5 cent each, so year-one net is about $450 — and ONLY if you were already going to spend $6,000 in six months. This 'best offer yet' is limited-time, ending 1/13/2027.
catches: Only claim this bonus if you were ALREADY going to spend $6,000 in six months — never spend extra to chase a bonus.
The $550 annual fee eats the bonus: 200,000 points at ~0.5 cent each is ~$1,000 minus $550 = ~$450 net year one.
This is a limited-time 'Best Hilton Points Offer Yet' ending 1/13/2027 — apply through the offer advertisement before then.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry.
Once-per-lifetime rule: you can only earn the Aspire welcome bonus once — not eligible if you have or have had this card.
Amex's eligibility check can deny the welcome offer based on your Card Member history and number of cards opened/closed; you are notified before processing so you can withdraw.
Carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR wipes out the bonus instantly — pay in full.

Fees, interest, cash advances, gift cards, prepaid reloads, and person-to-person payments don't count toward the $6,000 threshold; your spend window may be slightly shorter than 6 months depending on when you receive the card; account must not be past due or cancelled at fulfillment; bonus points don't count toward Hilton elite tier qualification.

steps: Open the official Amex Aspire terms/offer page and apply through the limited-time offer before 1/13/2027.
If Amex shows a no-bonus eligibility pop-up during the application, withdraw before the hard inquiry.

If approved, spend $6,000 on eligible purchases you were already planning within the first 6 months of Card Membership (watch the timing — the window can run slightly short depending on card delivery).
Pay the balance in full every month.
Keep the account open, not past due; the 200,000 points post to your Hilton Honors account 8-12 weeks after you hit $6,000.
Use the points for Hilton stays (worth roughly 0.5 cent each).
